name: audit
description: Detailed HTML audit of what changed in an OpenShift YAML repository (synchronized by oc.sync_yamls) since the previous audit.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: Git working tree on the server with the YAML files, usually the yaml_repository of oc.sync_yamls. Not needed with git_repository.

arguments.name: git_repository
arguments.description: A repository from Tools -> Git repositories (name or id), instead of 'repository'. One created from a server folder is audited in that folder and Entropy's copy updated with the audit commit; others are checked out into the run's workspace and the commit pushed back. When neither is given and exactly one repository is assigned to the plugin or workflow, that one is used.

arguments.name: report_directory
arguments.description: Where the HTML reports are kept. Default: '<repository>-audit' beside a folder repository, or the plugin's data folder (reports/<name>) for a Tools -> Git repositories repository. A directory inside the repository is added to its .gitignore.

arguments.name: retention_days
arguments.description: Reports older than this many days are removed; 0 keeps all reports.

arguments.name: commit
arguments.description: Commit the synchronized files after the audit, so the next audit reports only newer changes.

arguments.name: push
arguments.description: Push the audit commit to 'origin'. Default: on for git_repository (its checkout is temporary), off for a folder.

arguments.name: commit_message
arguments.description: Commit message; {date} and {summary} are filled in.

arguments.name: ignore_fields
arguments.description: More field paths to leave out of the report, added to the built-in ones (status, metadata.resourceVersion, ...).

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path of the HTML report written by this run (also a generated artifact).

outputs.name: reports
outputs.description: All reports kept in the report directory after rotation.

outputs.name: removed_reports
outputs.description: Reports removed because they were older than retention_days.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Counts: modified, added, removed resources and field/key changes.

outputs.name: commit
outputs.description: Short id of the audit commit; empty when nothing changed or committing is off.

outputs.name: base_commit
outputs.description: Commit the files were compared with; empty on the first audit.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: Working tree that was audited (the run's checkout for git_repository).

outputs.name: git_repository
outputs.description: The Tools -> Git repositories repository audited, if any.

outputs.name: pushed
outputs.description: Whether the audit commit was pushed to origin.
